## Before you install

Coming from an older copy: uninstall it first. Android will not install this over it, and stops
with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`. Uninstalling clears where you are in each book, your
bookmarks, and which folder your audiobooks are in — the audio files are untouched, and you point
the app back at the same folder on first launch. A widget you had placed has to be placed again.

Already on v1.6.0 or later: this installs over it and keeps everything.
